name: Prospect Ridge Resources Corp.
summary: Prospect Ridge Resources Corp. is a mineral exploration company focused on the identification, acquisition, and advancement of precious metal projects across North America. The company holds an exclusive option to acquire full ownership of two notable properties: the Galinee property, which encompasses 15 connected mineral claims covering approximately 839.45 hectares in Baie-James, Quebec; and the Holy Grail property, an extensive site spanning about 70,000 hectares located north of Terrace, British Columbia. Established in 2020, its corporate headquarters are situated in Vancouver, Canada.
